title: Team restructuring news
summary: Jordan learned in standup that Marcus is planning a Q4 team restructuring that could split their six-person team across two other squads, prompting Lena to confide she's already job-hunting after enduring a third reorg in two years. Jordan feels anxious and unsettled—this would be their second reorg in 14 months—and avoided processing the feeling by staying late to aimlessly organize old Figma files rather than going straight home. No concrete decisions were made, though Jordan vaguely plans to update their portfolio, possibly this weekend.
